summary: Implement the five approved novel commands in place of generated scaffolds: pulse, recipient-domains, email send-once (with an atomic send ledger reservation), servers bootstrap, templates check.
reason: The generator emits TODO scaffolds for novel features. These files hold the real implementations, plus the send-once ledger in the local store, and a regen would put the scaffolds back. The send-once ledger is keyed by Postmark's server ID, so every token for a server shares one ledger and same-named servers on different accounts stay separate.
validated_outcome: go test ./... passes, including TestPostmarkLedgerConcurrentReserveAcrossHandles (eight store handles race on one key; exactly one reserves it) and TestSendOnceFailureDisposition (a 5xx keeps the key reserved and later runs report delivery_unknown; a 4xx releases it). Each command returned correct live output during live dogfood.
